title: Run
description: One CI run: a single push to the customer repo, taken from trigger to terminal state. The root object the dashboard renders.

pushed_by.description: GitHub login that triggered the run.

robot_model.description: Resolved physical model. Null until RESOLVE_MODEL completes.

source.description: How the model was obtained. 'generated' means the Modeler agent synthesized MJCF.

name.description: Menagerie directory name or synthesized model name.

model_path.description: Absolute path to the MJCF file used by the suite.

confidence.description: Modeler's self-reported confidence that this model matches the real hardware.

suite.description: Aggregate result of the scenario matrix. Null until RUN_SUITE completes.

baseline_pass_rate.description: Pass rate before fixes, retained for before/after comparison in the report.

report_id.description: Id of the Report produced at REPORT.

error.description: Set when the run aborts for an infrastructure reason, not a robot failure.

stage.description: Pipeline stage. PASSED_CLEAN, PR_OPENED and FAILED_UNRESOLVED are terminal.
